page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.g9i family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 16 dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C vCPUs operating at a baseline clock speed of 3.2 GHz. This dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention from other tenants on the host.

The instance features 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. It does not include local storage or integrated graphics processing units, meaning all storage requirements must be met using network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps, facilitating reliable data transfer rates for standard network operations.

With its balanced compute-to-memory ratio and dedicated Intel Xeon processors, this instance offers a stable resource profile for general-purpose workloads. It is appropriate for application servers, web serving, containerized microservices, build systems, and mid-sized databases that rely on external network-attached storage.
